title: Historical evidence:at least nine arrests from October 2023 through December 2025

data.claim: WBTV reported that arrest records show Hunt was arrested at least nine times from October 2023 through December 2025, with charges including assault with a deadly weapon, communicating threats, assault on a female, and domestic-violence-order violations.
data.notes: This record counts arrests, not convictions; the nine events were not individually reconstructed from official dockets in this pass.
